editorial:
Imagine waking up to a cryptic message from your father right before he disappears at sea. That is exactly what happens to Sally Lockhart, a smart and independent woman who finds herself thrown into a dangerous world of crime and greed. You will get to experience a foggy, old-school London where opium dens and secret societies hide in the shadows. The vibe is very mysterious, and you will feel like you are solving a puzzle right along with Sally as she tries to figure out what the Seven Blessings actually mean and how they link back to a famous jewel.

What really works here is the acting and the way the mystery unfolds. The plot keeps you guessing, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you are looking for non-stop action. It is a great pick for anyone who loves a good detective story.
endingExplained: Everything comes together when Sally discovers that the ruby was stolen and used to fund a massive crime ring. After a tense confrontation, the truth about her father's death and the betrayal of those around her is revealed. The bad guys are finally caught, and Sally recovers the jewel. She finds peace knowing the truth about her family history, and the mystery of the Seven Blessings is finally solved in a satisfying way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Sherlock Holmes or old detective mysteries.
